subject: MedVora: MAP - deployment carveout & region geofence decision
messages:
From: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@medvora.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: MedVora Procurement <procurement@medvora.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:34:00 -0500
Subject: MAP kickoff: deployment mode + region constraints

Thanks Mateo — quick note to kick off the MAP for our deployment decision. High level: MedVora needs a MAP that gets us to a decision on Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private by mid-December; procurement is on a condensed timeline and AWS Marketplace purchase would be ideal if that path is acceptable.

Constraints to call out up front:
- PHI flows will live in the US only (no EU residency).
- We need an initial pilot in us-east with a hard latency target of p95 < 120ms for interactive chat.
- Procurement prefers marketplace + consolidated invoicing if available.

I've attached a short SOW draft and a combined list of procurement questions. Can you and your team map out the MAP with owners, evaluation plan (POC perf test + security checkpoints), and an expected close timeline? We have a leadership review on Dec 16.

Tom
Tom Hargreaves
Head of Platform Operations, MedVora
Tom.h@medvora.com

Attachments: MedVora_SOW_draft_v1.pdf
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@medvora.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: deployment mode + region constraints

Tom — thanks for the clear constraints. Team, putting a working MAP + evaluation plan below and attaching a timeline workbook (MAP_timeline_v2.xlsx).

Summary ask: decision by 2026-12-15 for go/no-go at leadership review (Dec 16). Proposed evaluation pillars:
- Performance & latency (p50/p95 under realistic load)
- Security & compliance (SOC2 artifacts, KMS/HSM for Private)
- Cost / unit economics (tokens/sec cost + infra)
- Operational complexity (integration, rollout risk)
- Procurement path & timeline (Marketplace vs PO)

Proposed plan (high level):
1) Week 1 (Dec 2–6): Kickoff + access; baseline perf run on Hosted in us-east (our hosted cluster) + quick Dedicated config.
2) Week 2 (Dec 7–10): Controlled POC for Dedicated (reserved pool) + Private feasibility review (customer-managed VPC & KMS requirements). Collect acceptance metrics.
3) Week 3 (Dec 11–14): Stitch findings into recommendation; finalize SOW + procurement channel.

Tie-breaker / geofence policy: if data residency and latency targets are both met by Hosted and Dedicated, prefer Hosted for speed of start and lower operational lift. Private is selected only if MedVora requires customer-controlled KMS/HSM or on-prem isolation that we cannot meet in Dedicated.

Acceptance criteria (for POC):
- p95 < 120ms for 99th percentile of interactive sessions in us-east for baseline test set
- Throughput target: sustained 120 concurrent chat sessions for 30 minutes with error rate <1%
- Security: SOC2 pointer + KMS integration plan signed off

Owners:
- Mateo: MAP owner / timeline and executive recommendation
- Camila: Onboarding & integration checklist / pilot runbook
- Karthik: Technical validation (latency/throughput, KV cache behavior, quantization implications)
- Mina: Procurement / legal liaison (marketplace routing + SOW)

Next steps: Camila, Karthik, Mina — can you validate the timeline and add any blockers? Tom — we'll aim to deliver the full MAP workbook by EOD Friday (Dec 4).

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_timeline_v2.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@medvora.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: deployment mode + region constraints

Quick tech notes to add to the MAP (keeping it tight):
- Private (on-prem/VPC) will introduce an additional delivery delta: estimate 6–8 weeks from contract to production if MedVora wants HSM-backed KMS + network isolation (includes customer infra validation).
- Dedicated gives predictable throughput and easier autoscaling. For the evaluation we should run identical model variants (quantized and FP16) to compare tail latency impact.
- KV cache warmup matters for p95; our POC will include a pre-warmed run to reflect steady-state.
- If MedVora insists on hardware-backed KMS in a Private deployment, there will be an additional security review and SOC2 re-scoping item.

Acceptance checklist (technical):
- Baseline p50/p95 numbers from Hosted (us-east) and Dedicated with the same test corpus
- Memory footprint and quantization regression test (sample prompt set)
- Failover plan: automatic fallback from Dedicated -> Hosted (if capacity constrained) must preserve data routing rules (no cross-region PHI).

I'll add a short appendix to the MAP timeline with detailed steps for the perf runs and what logs/metrics we'll capture.

- Karthik
Principal Inference Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@medvora.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: deployment mode + region constraints

Thanks — I added the onboarding & pilot runbook items into the MAP workbook (see attached SOW draft reference). Key items I put as actionables:
- Pilot scope: 10 clinical users, 1 integration endpoint, 2 model variants (small quantized, standard FP16)
- Data flows: all PHI scoped to us-east; no cross-region backups during pilot
- Success metrics: user satisfaction >= 85% on prompt set, latency p95 < 120ms, zero data leakage incidents
- Integration checklist owner: Camila (integration), engineering contact: Karthik

Procurement note: if we can route the initial Dedicated pilot through AWS Marketplace (Mina, can you confirm SKU and lead time), that will shorten contracting. If marketplace is not possible, procurement PO will add ~2 weeks.

Forwarding Tom's original SOW notes here for context:

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: deployment mode + region constraints — next steps and procurement path

Tom — quick confirmation and next steps from procurement side.

- Marketplace: There is an active Redwood SKU for the Dedicated pilot. If MedVora signs via AWS Marketplace we can get purchase order + provisioning in ~5 business days. I'll attach a pointer to our SOC2 evidence bundle for your review (SOC2_evidence_pointer.txt).
- If MedVora requires Private with customer-managed KMS, legal will need to redline the SOW and we will need the additional 6–8 week delivery window Karthik mentioned.

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm whether MedVora is willing to accept Dedicated as a first-step (Marketplace purchase) to hit the Dec 16 leadership review. Dedicated gives the same physical-region guarantee (us-east) and meets the procurement preference for marketplace routing.
2) If yes, sign the SOW draft (DocuSign link below) and I will push the SKU to the marketplace team.
